# NEW 2026-11-21 v9.6 Imperial Roads, Dynamic Country Names, Subject Stances & Flavor (oe_flv_, 0 slots). Generated by gen_v96_roads_flavor.py; edit the generator, not this file.

# Native on_road_built hook (avoids CIconDatabase<SRoadTypeIconDatabase> errors on nested blocks in road_types/*.txt).
on_road_built = {
	on_actions = {
		oe_flv_on_road_built
	}
}

oe_flv_on_road_built = {
	trigger = {
		current_year >= 1200
		is_ai = no
		is_rebel_country = no
		NOT = { oe_is_fourth_rome_exile_country = yes }
		exists = scope:road_type
	}
	effect = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				scope:road_type = road_type:oe_via_imperialis
				NOT = { has_variable = oe_flv_first_via_imperialis }
			}
			set_variable = { name = oe_flv_first_via_imperialis value = 1 }
			trigger_event_non_silently = oe_flv.10
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				scope:road_type = road_type:oe_yam_post_road
				NOT = { has_variable = oe_flv_first_yam_post_road }
			}
			set_variable = { name = oe_flv_first_yam_post_road value = 1 }
			trigger_event_non_silently = oe_flv.11
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				scope:road_type = road_type:oe_siberian_trakt
				NOT = { has_variable = oe_flv_first_siberian_trakt }
			}
			set_variable = { name = oe_flv_first_siberian_trakt value = 1 }
			trigger_event_non_silently = oe_flv.12
		}
	}
}
